description.narrative: Reduction in the Carbon Footprint: The Project will support greening of the cement operations in Cimkos three plants in Türkiye by improving energy intensity, emissions intensity, carbon intensity and increasing share of alternative fuel use. Deepening of Sustainability Practices: The Project will advance the sustainability practices of the local cement market in Türkiye by (i) increasing use of biomass-containing waste, (ii) improving effective waste/fuel management, (iii) reducing the clinker/cement ratio through optimizing clinker quality parameters and use of alternative additives; and (iv) upgrading utility water lines.

Çimko Çimento ve Beton San. Tic. A.S. (Cimko), a leading local cement manufacturer in Türkiye, launched a US$300 million 5-year Eurobond (the Eurobond) to be used to (i) refinance Cimkos existing short- to medium-term debt, (ii) fund Cimkos mostly sustainability-focused capital expenditures over 2025-2027; and (iii) general corporate purposes, including upgrades in management information systems and working capital financing (the Project). IFC participated in this debut issue with a subscription of US$50 million as an anchor investor.
